name: Formation pitch diagram renders at least twenty-two position markers
description: When a visitor opens the Lineups panel on a match page, a pitch silhouette diagram renders player position markers, with at least twenty-two markers present across both teams so all eleven positions per side are plotted on the pitch.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Open the Lineups tab or scroll to the lineups region
Locate the formation pitch diagram element
Verify the pitch diagram is a visible graphical element such as an SVG or canvas, not a placeholder image
Verify the pitch diagram contains at least twenty-two position markers such as circles or numbered nodes, covering eleven players per team
